about_the_game:
Heroes and Forsaken is the official Wheel of Time digital card game. Build powerful decks under Leader identities, choose Light or Shadow, and face off in fast, tactical matches set across the world of The Wheel of Time. Command legendary characters and spells, outplay your rival, and shape the fate of the Age.

Align with the great powers of the world. From the White Tower to the Borderlands, from the Aiel to the Seanchan Empire, each path offers unique cards, abilities, and strategies rooted in Wheel of Time lore.

Collect and master a growing library of cards inspired by the characters, magic, and history of the series. Combine Leaders, companions, spells, and artifacts to build decks that match your preferred playstyle.

Battle across a striking 3D board with animated companions and magical effects. The presentation aims to capture the grandeur and danger of the Wheel of Time universe.

Experiment with deck combinations, adapt to your opponent’s tactics, and refine your strategy over time. Competitive online play and additional modes are planned. Details will be shared closer to launch.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS 64-bit or SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360 (2GB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS 64-bit or SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 (4GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
